data.description: Portofino: A Perfect Blend of Waterfront Living, Business, and Leisure in the Heart of DAMAC Lagoons.

data.answer:
Portofino in DAMAC Lagoons Dubai offers luxurious residences surrounded by crystal-clear lagoons and a range of waterside amenities. Beyond the well-designed homes, the community provides everything needed for a productive workspace, including soundproof office pods equipped with modern facilities, nestled amidst lush greenery to inspire creativity.

Host team meetings or attend business calls from your aqua office while enjoying breathtaking sunset views. The community also features outdoor glass-enclosed rooms for private meetings, offering a serene setting for work. When it’s time to unwind, enjoy live performances at the open-air music pavilion or relax with your laptop in the dedicated leisure areas.

The community’s appeal is further enhanced by its convenient connectivity to the city’s center and access to nearby amenities. These features position Portofino at DAMAC Lagoons as a top choice among off-plan investment opportunities in Dubai.

Portofino community in DAMAC Lagoons offers an elegant collection of waterfront villas and townhouses. Buyers can choose from 3, 4, 5, and 7-bedroom homes, available in two or three-story layouts, each crafted with high-quality finishes and furnishings. The ground floor typically includes a spacious living and dining area, a fitted kitchen, a guest bedroom, and a maid’s room.

On the first floor, residents will find additional bedrooms and a terrace with scenic waterfront views. The larger 7-bedroom villas also feature a private indoor gym and pool. Each home comes with in-house parking and a garden, adding to the appeal of these luxury residences.

Buying a Property in Portofino, DAMAC Lagoons

Portifino villas in DAMAC Lagoons offer spacious 3 to 7-bedroom layouts, designed to reflect Mediterranean-inspired architecture. The homes feature modern layouts with high-quality finishes and are set against a scenic backdrop of lagoons and lush landscapes. 

Given the area's luxury lifestyle offerings and proximity to essential amenities, Portofino is an attractive option for both investors and end-users.

Living in Portofino, DAMAC Lagoons is a blend of relaxation and vibrancy, designed to offer residents a seamless work-life balance. The community provides a serene setting, with soundproof office pods and outdoor meeting spaces to foster productivity. 

At the same time, residents can enjoy leisure facilities, such as an open-air music pavilion, lagoons, and scenic promenades. The thoughtfully curated environment creates a sense of tranquility, making it ideal for families, professionals, and anyone seeking a refreshing lifestyle away from the city’s hustle.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Portofino

Portofino is designed to be a car-friendly community with ample parking spaces available within each residence. Townhouses and villas come with private parking, ensuring convenience for residents. 

Nearby bus stops include J103 and J104, providing easy access to areas such as DAMAC Hills and Remraam.

Supermarkets in Portofino

DAMAC Lagoons’ community features a supermarket where residents can shop for daily essentials. Other popular grocery stores like Big Guy Supermarketares are located in DAMAC Hills which is just a short drive away.

Shopping Mall in Portofino

Residents of the Portofino community in DAMAC Lagoons enjoy convenient access to several shopping destinations. First Avenue Mall – Motor City is just 11 minutes away, City Centre Me'aisem is a 14-minute drive, Cityland Mall – Global Village is reachable within 16 minutes, and the renowned Mall of the Emirates is only 24 minutes from the community.

Schools and Nurseries in Portofino

Families with children will find several reputable schools and nurseries close to Portofino. These include international institutions offering British, American, and IB curricula, such as GEMS Education and Dubai International Academy. Younger children have access to nearby nurseries that focus on early childhood development, providing quality care and learning within a safe environment.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Portofino

Portofino caters to the diverse spiritual needs of its residents, with mosques located within the DAMAC Lagoons community and in nearby areas. For those of other faiths, churches and temples are easily accessible in neighboring districts such as Jebel Ali, where multiple places of worship are located, ensuring that residents can practice their faith comfortably.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Portofino

Living in Portofino DAMAC Lagoons provides residents with easy access to quality healthcare facilities. Aster Medical Centre is just 9 minutes away, Mediclinic Parkview Hospital can be reached in 12 minutes, and NMC Royal Hospital is a 19-minute drive from the community.

Location & Nearby Areas

Portofino is located within the DAMAC Lagoons community in Dubailand adjacent to Hessa Street. It is within walking distance of Al Khail Street (E44) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), providing excellent connectivity.

Portofino properties for sale in DAMAC Lagoons offer a variety of recreational activities that cater to different interests. Residents can enjoy water-based activities, such as kayaking and paddleboarding, along the community’s lagoons. 

The open-air music pavilion hosts regular performances, creating a lively ambiance for residents to relax and socialize. Additionally, scenic walkways and parks within the community provide the perfect setting for strolls or morning jogs.

Restaurants

Dining in and around Portofino offers a mix of casual and dining experiences. The community features several cafes and bistros overlooking the lagoons, offering residents a chance to enjoy scenic views while dining. You’ll find several restaurants such as PRATO and Doner Kebab in DAMAC Lagoons.

Beaches Near Portofino

For those who enjoy beachside relaxation, Jumeirah Beach is just a 20-minute drive away. This is where you can enjoy sun-soaked shores, water sports, and beachside cafes. Residents can also enjoy beachfront amenities and tranquil waterfront views without leaving the DAMAC Lagoons community.

Hotels in Portofino

While Portofino is primarily a residential area, several luxury hotels and resorts are located nearby, providing options for visiting guests. Iconic hotels like Atlantis, The Pal,m and Jumeirah Beach Hotel are easily accessible, offering world-class hospitality. These hotels also provide residents with opportunities to enjoy spa days, fine dining, and recreational activities.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Adding to the signature DAMAC charm, the developer has introduced unique communal amenities for Portofino residents. These include an aqua library, a fully equipped gym, and an outdoor spa, offering a blend of relaxation and convenience. DAMAC Lagoons Portofino amenities include a serene fishing lake and an observatory, enhancing the leisure experience within this waterfront villa enclave.

Community Events

Portofino hosts a variety of community events throughout the year, fostering a sense of belonging among residents. Events such as outdoor movie nights, food festivals, and fitness challenges provide opportunities for socializing and engaging with neighbors. These activities help create a close-knit community that values interaction and shared experiences.

Attractions and Landmarks

The family-friendly community, Portofino in DAMAC Lagoons is surrounded by several of Dubai’s most popular attractions and landmarks. Residents can easily explore places like the Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, and the Burj Khalifa, which are all within a short drive.

Closer to home, the DAMAC Lagoons community offers a range of entertainment options, including themed parks and recreational facilities.

While Portofino offers an exceptional lifestyle, it is important to consider that the community is still under development, with handovers expected in 2025. As an off-plan project, residents will need to factor in construction timelines and future development plans. 

However, with its luxurious offerings and strategic location, Portofino remains a promising investment opportunity for those seeking a blend of tranquility and modern living in Dubai.

What type of properties are available in Portofino, in DAMAC Lagoons?

DAMAC Lagoons Portofino real estate properties feature 3, 4, 5, and 7-bedroom waterfront villas and townhouses.

Is Portofino complete?

Portofino in DAMAC Lagoons is currently under development, with handovers expected in 2025.

data.content:
Portofino is a newly launched development by DAMAC Properties. It is nestled within the Mediterranean-themed community of DAMAC Lagoons. This off-plan project offers a blend of luxury townhouses and villas, designed to capture the charm of waterfront cities. Residents can expect a vibrant lifestyle surrounded by stunning outdoor spaces and Italian-themed architecture.

Part of one of the eight sub-districts in DAMAC Lagoons, Portofino features residences ranging from 4 to 7-bedroom villas and townhouses. It also serves as a work-and-play hub, with dedicated office spaces and recreational facilities, catering to both business needs and leisure activities in a picturesque environment.

Offering a mix of lifestyle, business, and outdoor experiences, Portofino promises to redefine luxury living in Dubai’s growing real estate landscape.
